prompt.project_info: Close-up photorealistic post-workout gym selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with red hair in a loose messy wet ponytail, strands on the forehead and neck, fair flushed skin with visible pores and freckles, expressive blue eyes, relaxed tired smile and playful confident expression; wearing a light-pink ribbed sports bra or tank crop top with thick straps and a flattering scoop neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Arm's-length close-up selfie, head slightly tilted and shoulders relaxed, one arm cropped while holding the phone; blurred modern gym equipment, weight machines, cable pulleys, exposed pipes and dark rubber floor behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright slightly harsh overhead fluorescent lighting creates strong realistic highlights on sweat and soft shadows under the chin; natural post-exercise glow and casual athletic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic close-up, front-low arm's-length angle, sharp sweat and skin detail, shallow depth of field and realistic gym bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic close-up post-workout gym selfie of a clearly adult original red-haired woman with a loose messy wet ponytail, flushed freckled skin, expressive blue eyes and tired playful confidence, wearing a light-pink ribbed sports bra or tank crop top with thick straps and flattering scoop neckline, leaning slightly toward the camera, bright overhead fluorescent light, blurred gym machines and exposed pipes, sharp sweat texture and natural athletic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, cleavage emphasis, transparent clothing, logos, text, watermark, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, over-smooth skin
